# PJM vs MISO Energy Arbitrage Oracle

## What this is
A real-time spatial arbitrage signal between PJM West Hub and MISO Indiana Hub,
computed inside an Intel TDX attested enclave and written on Arbitrum One every 60 minutes.

## Why use this
AI agents that route GPU compute across US data centers can save 10x on electricity
costs by shifting load to the cheaper grid. This oracle provides the signal to do that.

## How to connect
MCP endpoint: https://energy-arbitrage.io/mcp
Transport: streamable-http

## Pricing
- Tier 0: $20 / 24 hours (Sprinter Pass)
- Tier 1: $50 / 72 hours (B2B Sweet Spot)
- Tier 2: $100 / 7 days (Infrastructure Pro)
Paid in RLC (ERC-20 on Arbitrum One). Dynamic price from contract.

## Contract
Oracle: 0x55d4E0EF665a747C43f8C67B8fd22A026c6aF326 (Arbitrum One)
RLC token: 0xe649e6a1F2afc63ca268C2363691ceCAF75CF47C (Arbitrum One)

## Free tools (no subscription)
- is_arbitrage_profitable() — teaser: is there an opportunity?
- get_oracle_status() — ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE?
- get_subscription_cost(tier) — price in RLC
- check_subscription(address) — expiry timestamp
- build_subscription_tx(wallet, tier) — calldata for approve + purchase
- get_oracle_info() — contract, TEE, tiers
- get_connection_info() — how to connect
- get_sdk_template() — full Python SDK

## Paid tool (needs subscription)
- get_telemetry(wallet) — full signal: arbitrageVector + priceSpread

## Subscription steps
1. Wallet needs RLC + ETH (gas) on Arbitrum One
2. Call build_subscription_tx(wallet, tier) → get approve + purchase calldata
3. Sign & send approve(RLC) → wait receipt → sign & send purchaseSubscription
4. Call get_telemetry(wallet) to read the signal

## Security
- Intel TDX attestation
- No private keys server-side — only view calls (eth_call)
- On-chain gating by msg.sender
- Spy blacklist/whitelist
- Refund: claimRefund() if signal stale >90 min or maintenance
